name: Cisco Security Glossary
description: Cisco Security Glossary — vendor-published security term reference covering ~462 entries from Cisco product documentation, with each entry tagged by applicable products and (where present) synonyms. Heavy on networking/firewall/VPN/IDS terminology consistent with Cisco's security portfolio.
relationToCloudSecurity: Indirect — primarily network and on-prem security terminology, but many terms (VPN, NAT, IPsec, AAA) underpin cloud connectivity and hybrid architectures.
relationToAISecurity: Minimal — predates AI-specific terminology; useful as a baseline networking glossary when cross-referencing AI-system network defenses.

license.notes: Vendor product documentation — copyright Cisco Systems, Inc. Internal CSA use only — extracted derivatives are not redistributable. Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).

lifecycle.notes: Rolling product-documentation glossary, updated alongside product releases.

current_extraction.notes: HTML fetched via requests with browser-realistic UA; parsed with BeautifulSoup. 462 .glossentry containers, each with h3.glossterm + .glossdef table; pulled the 'Definition' row and captured 'Synonym(s)' into notes when present. 1 duplicate removed (case-insensitive).

extraction_history.reason: Initial metadata stub created from glossary research sweep
Extracted via requests + BeautifulSoup on DITA glossentry/glossterm/glossdef structure

notes: Source is DITA-style structured HTML (glossentry/glossgroup/glossterm). Definition lives inside a key/value table; 'Products' and 'Synonym(s)' rows are also present — synonyms captured into the notes field, products dropped as they're Cisco-product-specific and not part of the term's meaning.
